thread:
Megan: Quick sync — post-launch 'bug buffet' for the next 2 weeks. We need to decide how to split headcount between P0/P1 bugs and two small customer-driven enhancements. Proposal: 3 engineers on high-priority bugs, 1 owner for the enhancement spike+ship, 1 person for prioritization/liaison with CS. Thoughts?

Chris: +1 to prioritizing P0/P1 first. If we push enhancements before fixing regressions we risk more churn. :+1:

Sarah: Sales/CS are asking for the widget alignment enhancement for Acme. It's small but visible. Can we commit 1 engineer for a 2-day spike then 1 day to ship?

Dmitri: That seems reasonable if we isolate it from core runtime changes. Suggest triage order: P0 (hotfix), P1 (impacting >1 customer), regressions flagged by monitoring, then low-frequency items and enhancements.

Emma: Also flagging the streaming regression that started after deploy — it's causing timeouts for some customers. @Dmitri can you own a quick canary and rollback plan?

Dmitri: I can take the streaming regression. Will create a canary and rollback doc this afternoon.

Megan: Tentative plan: 3-dev bug squad (Dmitri, Raj, Priya), 1 enhancement owner (Sarah) for the Acme widget, 1 prioritization/CS liaison (Megan). Confirm by EOD so we can update roadmap & notify CS.

Raj: I'm in for the bug squad. I'll run first triage pass tomorrow morning and label P0/P1 in JIRA.

Priya: I'll cover ops-related errors and dig into alarm noise, might be some false positives from the new batching config.

Sarah: I'll scope the enhancement as an MVE: 2-day spike, 1-day implement, no API changes. If spike shows bigger work, we'll gate on customer commit.

pm-bot: Reminder — shipping policy requires QA signoff + customer comms for any changes affecting visible UI or API.

Chris: We should also push the 'micro-release' milestone into the roadmap and mark it 'in progress' for visibility. @Megan can you update the board and the release notes template?

Megan: Will update roadmap and release notes. I'll draft an email for CS — short note with mitigation, ETA, and 'who to contact'.

Dmitri: For triage, I'll use this JIRA filter to keep everyone synced:
```
project = INF AND (priority in (P0, P1) OR labels in (streaming-reg)) ORDER BY priority, updated DESC
```
I'll drop the link in #product after I push it.

Megan: Decision summary: 3-dev bug squad (Dmitri/Raj/Priya), 1 enhancement owner (Sarah), roadmap + CS comms by EOD. If anyone can't make their slot, call it out now. Otherwise we execute. :white_check_mark:

Raj: Got it.

Priya: On it.

Sarah: Confirmed.

Emma: Thanks — I'll stand by for the canary results.

Megan: Thanks team — will post updated milestone and the CS template in this thread when done.
